title: Woman at Washington Monument, 1940s Sepia Snapshot, Washington DC
description: A vintage 1940s snapshot featuring a woman posing at the base of the Washington Monument on the National Mall in Washington, D.C. Dressed in 1940s fashion with styled dark hair and a knee-length dress, she points upwards toward the top of the towering obelisk. The photo exhibits a lens flare effect across the lower portion, characteristic of mid-century amateur photography.
